legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors, assigns, and personal representatives.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Assignee against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising out of or related to the Original Contract.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising out of or related to this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations associated with the transfer of the Property.
